cohort: The cohort comprised 24,236 adults who experienced a first-ever stroke/TIA and were admitted to hospitals in Queensland and Victoria, Australia, between 2012 and 2016.
finding: Disparities in medication adherence after stroke/TIA were observed, with participants born in Other Oceania and Southern/Central Asia showing lower adherence to lipid-lowering and antithrombotic medications compared to Australian-born participants.
